vignette.name: PythonTap Package Overview
vignette.p: Write Max objects in Python. PythonTap runs a Python class as a Max object: the class's typed fields become attributes, its methods messages, and saving the file reloads it in place. It comes with CPython 3.13, numpy and attrs.

ul.li: tap.python~ - Process audio with a Python class: its process() method runs on the signal, per sample or per vector.
tap.python - Run a Python class as a Max object without audio: what a method returns is what it outputs.
Writing Max Objects in Python - the guide to both objects.
